title: SplatPaint browser sandbox for painting and editing Gaussian splats
summary: SplatPaint is a real-time browser creative sandbox for Gaussian splats: paint, sculpt, recolor, relight, deform, animate, and layer particle FX. Converts images, logos, or 3D models into splats inside the app; alpha.splatpaint.app was free for 48 hours at post time.
question_it_answers: Which browser tool lets you paint, sculpt, and relight Gaussian splats without a pre-made asset?

claims.text: SplatPaint supports paint, sculpt, recolor, relight, deform, animate, and particle FX on splats in the browser.
claims.evidence: paint, sculpt, recolor, relight, deform, animate, and layer wicked particle system FX.
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting

claims.text: Users can convert an image, logo, or 3D model into splats inside SplatPaint without an existing splat file.
claims.evidence: Grab an image, logo, or 3D model, convert it into splats (inside SplatPaint), and start building something unique.
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting
